name: Simien National Park
description: Simien National Park sits in the Amhara Region of northern Ethiopia, where long erosion has carved the plateau into jagged peaks, deep valleys and cliffs that plunge about 1,500 metres. It includes Ras Dashan, the country's highest point. Visitors may spot gelada baboons, Simien foxes and the walia ibex, a wild goat found nowhere else, while bearded vultures glide overhead on three-metre wingspans.
